notes.title: Update 1.05: New Game Mode!
notes.notes:
+New game mode: New games will automatically start in "Normal" mode. In this mode the building mechanic is simplified. Buildings can now be constructed by having items in inventory -> click on building -> press build. Players can switch to "Realism" mode via the options screen which restores the more complex building mechanic. 
+Improved tutorial system: More nav markers with clearer information on what to build first.
+Fixed bug where players may not be rewarded monetarily for constructing businesses. 
+Increased night time build reward to 6 hours instead of 4.
+New games now start with access to 5 Nitro's which give speed boost to forklift.
+Amended Kens purchasing logic so he will no longer buy Nitro's.

notes.title: Steam Deck Controller Support
notes.notes:
At the moment, touch-Screen is still used for menu navigation. Please keep an eye on our updates for Steam Deck specific improvements as they come in.

Main Controls:

A - Interact
B - Drone
X - Tool Cycle
L2 - Secondary Interact 
R2 - Left Mouse Click equivalent

notes.title: New Year Update
notes.notes:
We've been busy making our new tutorial system and streamlining the first hour or so of gameplay. As we get closer to launch we are focusing in on those first initial moments in Ekoh Beach and creating some tasks that feel right.

Our new Demo is nearly ready too. We are registered for Steam Next Fest and we have to have our Demo all shiny and ready for the start of the festival in February. Its and exiting time for us as we prepare for launch and it will be both awesome and terrifying to have our Demo out to the public during Next Fest!

Functionality-wise we are pretty stable right now and have been polishing existing stuff rather than adding new stuff (well...with the exception of the new Tutorial). We did however add a new Player House, which we didn't expect to do but it made a lot as the tutorial started to take shape.

Our playtesting right now is geared toward the later game and completionism which I guess is a good sign at this stage of development!

The Zenland Team.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
After 4+ years of development we are delighted to post our official release date of [b]Spring 2025![/b]

Its been a journey that we never could have predicted! Having almost released in 2022 (boy are we glad we didn't!), we received some wonderful support from our friends and colleagues in Sweden and Ireland that allowed us to create the game we always wanted to.

For the next few months; its gonna be filled with lots of playtesting and resisting the urge to add things when we have the thought "oh wouldn't it be nice if..." ːsteamhappyː

Thanks so much to everyone who has put us on their Wishlist, it means a lot to a small team. We will in these last few months work as hard as ever to make a game you'll hopefully love!

Thanks,

Team Zenland
(Ireland and Sweden)

notes.title: A whole lot-a-development!
notes.notes:
Well its been a busy two years! We were going to release in 2022  but truthfully we just weren't ready. Over the last two years we've leaned quite heavily into the "Tropical Sci-Fi" vibe and piece by piece reworked the entire map / characters /buildings / machines /enemies (and even the UI!) until we had the world we wanted to create. We've certainly learned a lot and now we feel we have finally come in to our own identity. We've recently been smoothing out the main game loop and now we're adding some fun little characters. We've picked a date for release which WILL be early 2025.

From here on in we'll be posting regular updates! Thanks!
